entities.summary: Patrick Joseph Nilan OAM was an Australian field hockey player who competed in the 1964 Summer Olympics, in the 1968 Summer Olympics, and in the 1972 Summer Olympics. Born in Sydney on 30 June 1941, Nilan died on 10 May 2024, at the age of 82.
